event_summary: A large vertical metal cylinder stays centered over wrinkled metal scraps while a dark rod-like object intermittently enters from the right and moves near the right-side scrap.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a stationary-looking vertical shiny cylindrical assembly with a wider round lower section positioned over rust-brown wrinkled sheet fragments on a flat work surface. A larger bent sheet piece remains arched on the left side. Early in the sequence, a dark slender rod-like object appears from the right and moves toward the right-side sheet edge, then recedes. The central cylinder and most scraps remain in nearly the same visible positions. Later, the dark rod-like object reappears from the right, sweeps near or under the right-side sheet edge, and withdraws again. The camera view remains fixed.

reasons: The central metal cylinder, work surface, and surrounding sheet fragments are already visible at the start.
The event appears to be ongoing rather than starting from an empty or untouched setup.
Some sheet material beneath the central cylinder is partially hidden by the cylinder.
